name: Heat Haze
description: Stylized heat distortion with exact-load rising heat advection, fast convection packets, held-pointer injection, click thermal fronts, diffusion, and audio shimmer.

updatedParams.name: Heat Gain
updatedParams.description: Injection rate into the heat field, which lives in dataTextureA/C rather than the depth texture; also gains the buoyant updraft packets.

updatedParams.name: Decay Rate
updatedParams.description: Cooling rate of the heat field between frames.

updatedParams.name: Diffusion
updatedParams.description: Lateral spread of the heat field per step.

updatedParams.name: Refraction
updatedParams.description: Mirage displacement gain; also scales the shear-layer shimmer streaks.
